claim.claim-text: 1. A user equipment (200) comprising:

a transmitter/receiver (220) configured, when the first uplink message of the two-step random access procedure is selected, to: transmit the selected first uplink message to the base station, and receive a random access response of the two-step random access procedure, the random access response corresponding to the transmitted first uplink message,

characterized in that the random access response of the two-step random access procedure is scheduled by a Physical Downlink Control Channel, PDCCH, whose Cyclic Redundancy Check, CRC, is scrambled by a first Random Access Radio Network Temporary Identifier, RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure, and in that the first RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure is calculated to include a predetermined offset value for the second RA-RNTI used in the four-step random access procedure.
2. The user equipment according to claim 1, wherein the first uplink message contains a random access preamble message and a Physical Uplink Shared Channel, PUSCH, message.

3. The user equipment according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the first RA-RNTI is determined based on a time resource and a frequency resource of the selected first uplink message corresponding to the random access response.

4. The user equipment according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the transmitter/receiver (220) is further configured to receive, from the base station, setting information including a selection reference of whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message, wherein the selector (210) is further configured to select, based on the selection reference, whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message.
5. A base station (100) comprising:

a transmitter/receiver (130) configured to: receive from a user equipment, a first uplink message of a two-step random access procedure, or a second uplink message of a four-step random access procedure, and
transmit a random access response of the two-step random access procedure when the first uplink message is received,

characterized in that the random access response of the two-step random access procedure is scheduled by a Physical Downlink Control Channel, PDCCH, whose Cyclic Redundancy Check, CRC, is scrambled by a first Random Access Radio Network Temporary Identifier, RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure, and in that the first RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure is calculated to include a predetermined offset value for the second RA-RNTI used in the four-step random access procedure.
6. The base station according to claim 5, wherein the first uplink message contains a random access preamble message and a Physical Uplink Shared Channel, PUSCH, message.

7. The base station according to claim 5 or 6, wherein the first RA-RNTI is determined based on a time resource and a frequency resource of the selected first uplink message corresponding to the random access response.

8. The base station according to any one of claims 5 to 7, wherein the transmitter/receiver (130) is further configured to transmit, to the user equipment, setting information including a selection reference of whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message by the user equipment, wherein the selection reference is used by the user equipment to select, whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message.
9. A method of user equipment (200) comprising:

when the first uplink message of the two-step random access procedure is selected, transmitting the selected first uplink message to the base station, and receiving a random access response of the two-step random access procedure, the random access response corresponding to the transmitted first uplink message,

characterized in that the random access response of the two-step random access procedure is scheduled by a Physical Downlink Control Channel, PDCCH, whose Cyclic Redundancy Check, CRC, is scrambled by a first Random Access Radio Network Temporary Identifier, RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure, and in that the first RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure is calculated to include a predetermined offset value for the second RA-RNTI used in the four-step random access procedure.
10. The method according to claim 9, wherein the first uplink message contains a random access preamble message and a Physical Uplink Shared Channel, PUSCH, message.

11. The method according to claim 9 or 10, wherein the first RA-RNTI is determined based on a time resource and a frequency resource of the selected first uplink message corresponding to the random access response.
12. The method according to any one of claims 9 to 11, wherein the method further comprises:

receiving, from the base station, setting information including a selection reference of whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message, wherein whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message is selected based on the selection reference,.
13. A method of a base station (100) comprising:
receiving from a user equipment, a first uplink message of a two-step random access procedure, or a second uplink message of a four-step random access procedure, and

transmitting a random access response of the two-step random access procedure when the first uplink message is received, characterized in that the random access response of the two-step random access procedure is scheduled by a Physical Downlink Control Channel, PDCCH, whose Cyclic Redundancy Check, CRC, is scrambled by a first Random Access Radio Network Temporary Identifier, RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure, and in that the first RA-RNTI used in the two-step random access procedure is calculated to include a predetermined offset value for the second RA-RNTI used in the four-step random access procedure.

14. The method according to claim 13, wherein the first uplink message contains a random access preamble message and a Physical Uplink Shared Channel, PUSCH, message, or wherein the first RA-RNTI is determined based on a time resource and a frequency resource of the selected first uplink message corresponding to the random access response.
15. The method according to any one of claims 13 to 14, wherein the method further comprises:

transmitting, to the user equipment, setting information including a selection reference of whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message by the user equipment, wherein the selection reference is used by the user equipment to select, whether to transmit the first uplink message or the second uplink message.
